newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Uneximbank gets $50 mln Citibank-led credit.
newsitem.headline: Russia Uneximbank gets $50 mln Citibank-led credit.

text.p: Russia's Uneximbank has received an extendable six-month $50 million credit at LIBOR plus 4.125 percent from a syndicate of banks led by Citibank and New Alliance Corp, Uneximbank said Monday.

The 21-bank syndicate from 15 countries in Europe, the U.S. and Asia, signed an agreement for the credit, the first by Uneximbank (Oneksimbank in Russian) on the international market, on April 30 in London, Uneximbank said.
Uneximbank was Russia's third largest bank in 1996 by assets, according to Russian accounting standards, and controls metals producer Norilsk Nickel NKEL.RTS and other industrial interests.
